content: दीर्घ {%a.%} (<ab>Compar.</ab> द्राधीयस्, Superl. द्राघिष्ठ) .²1 Long (in time or space), reaching far; दीर्घाक्षं शरदिन्दुकान्ति वदनम् <ls>M. 2. 3</ls>; दीर्घान् कटाक्षान् <ls>Me. 37</ls>; दीर्घापाङ्ग <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Of long duration, lasting long, tedious; दीर्घयामा त्रियामा <ls>Me. 110</ls>; <ls>V. 3. 4</ls>; <ls>Ś. 4. 15</ls>. .²3 Deep (as a sigh); <ls>Amaru. 13</ls>; दीर्घमुष्णं च निश्वस्य. .²4 Long (as a vowel), as the आ in काम. .²5 Lofty, high, tall. .²6 Dilated, expanded; तृष्णादीर्घस्य चक्षुषः <ls>U. 3. 46</ls>. .{@-र्घः@} .²1 A camel. .²2 A long vowel. .²3 The fifth, sixth, seventh, and eighth signs of the zodiac. .²4 A kind of grass or reed. .{@-र्घा@} A long lake or oblong tank. .{@-र्घम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Long, for a long time. .²2 Deeply. .²3 Far.
